analogy.rationale: Platelet aggregation inhibitors share PTGS1/PTGS2 (cyclooxygenase) and prostanoid/thromboxane pathways with cyclooxygenase inhibitors and thromboxane/prostanoid antagonists, while PPAR and TRPV targets reflect off-target or weak-expression receptors. In these non-platelet cell lines, the canonical platelet aggregation program is largely absent, so the response should be weak.
